== Biography ==
The John Glasgow represented by the 1777 St Cuthberts child record was born on 5 September 1777 and baptised on 11 September 1777. The derivative transcript names Alexander Glasgow, brewer, and Agnes Cunningham. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1321|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Cunninghame-96|Agnes Cunninghame]].

May be the same person as [[Glasgow-1348|John Glasgow (abt.1770-)]]
